sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 14 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：IBM、MSFT、MU、SNDK、SPY。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • IBM earnings-warning-style blowup, intraday $223.9, -22.87%, its worst single day since 1987. Ahead of the official 7/22 earnings release, it suddenly issued preliminary results: revenue 172 hundred million vs expected 178.5 hundred million, adjusted EPS 2.93 vs 3.02, GAAP EPS 2.27 (-2% YoY). CEO Krishna admitted the company "faltered," with multiple large deals failing to close on schedule, and said that in late June customers temporarily shifted capex from software to server/storage/memory to secure tight capacity, with the "degree of reprioritization exceeding expectations." This smashed the entire SaaS sector.
  • June CPI came in sharply below expectations: headline 3.5% YoY (expected 3.8–3.9, prior 4.2%), MoM -0.4% (largest monthly decline since April 2020), core 2.6% YoY, core MoM 0.0%. The main driver was gasoline -9.7%, while apparel, used cars, and housing also softened. But the decline came almost entirely from energy, and oil prices surged again after the CPI measurement period—USO is currently $120.7, +2.51%, creating a disconnect of "the report is cool, reality is heating up."
  • Warsh appeared at the House semiannual monetary policy hearing at 10:00 ET: he pledged to "defeat inflation," stayed silent on the rate-cut path, continued his style of scrapping forward guidance, and specifically said the AI investment boom itself is pushing up inflation. The community circulated claims that CME rate-cut bets fell instead of rising (affected by the rekindled war in Iran), with no official confirmation yet.
  • Iran/Hormuz escalation: Iranian lawmakers submitted a "strait management bill," requiring all transiting vessels to apply for permits, declare cargo, pay fees, and use only the term "Persian Gulf," with violators facing confiscation of up to 20% of cargo value. Multiple tankers in the strait have already been attacked. The community cited The Intercept as saying U.S. military casualties occurred (pending authoritative confirmation; listed as rumor for now).
  • Major banks diverged after earnings beats: JPM $340.5, +1.77% (after failing to stay green premarket, it staged a V-shaped rebound; the community called it an "epic reversal"), BAC +1.50% turned stronger; WFC $87.4, -0.35% remained sell-the-news.
  • Index status 27 minutes after open: SPY $751.0, +0.25% (basically flat), QQQ $718.98, +1.00% (semiconductors leading), DIA flat, IWM +0.50%. Overnight futures surged on CPI and then clearly gave back gains before the open, showing a posture of "the bullish impulse has been digested."

社区气氛：总体来说，这是一种“贪婪与怀疑并存的混乱看涨倾斜”——有利的CPI引发了“降息卷土重来，BERS灭绝”的狂潮，半导体和航天股飙升，但主导声音是“数据被煮熟了（Cooked CPI）”，开盘后冲动涨势就消退了，IBM的黑天鹅击垮了软件。大多数人都在大喊大叫，同时怀疑这是“历史上最明显的牛市陷阱”。

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪但高度神经质。半导体、太空和贵金属均上涨（GDX +4.03%），表明风险偏好活跃；但对 CPI 真实性的普遍不信任以及 IBM 造成的“大盘单日-23%”波动的冲击让人们不敢追逐。

情绪与现实：社区感觉正处于“千兆泵/空头灭绝”的环境中，但实际市场 SPY 仅小幅上涨，道琼斯指数持平，而 QQQ 的 +1% 几乎完全由内存/半导体承载。软件是深绿色的，方向错误（NOW -5.75%，ADBE -4.30%，CRM -3.46%，MSFT -1.85%）。情绪的兴奋程度显然高于指数的实际涨幅。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
IBM90+看跌（抄底声音出现）盈利预警暴涨-23%，为1987年以来最严重； EPS 仅比 7 月 22 日的官方财报低 2-3%，大多数人认为这种反应过度； CEO认错+大笔交易未签是核心负面因素；分歧集中在“AI 吃掉 SaaS”是否成立；一些人呼吁反弹至 250-260 美元，并推测伯克希尔可能会抄底，而其他人则买入看跌期权并陷入困境
MU45+看涨+3.76%，多次冲击1000美元但失败成焦点； IBM的“客户抢内存”被视为看涨的硬证据； “属于 1100/1200”，但怨恨依然存在，“每次我卖出它都是 50 倍，每次我持有它都是 -99%”；关闭超过 1k “我要学韩语”表情包
MSFT40+看跌/被动-1.85%，被称为“逆SPY”，一个纯粹的泵指标；被社区最大怨恨股IBM拖累；全港持有者集体哀号； “在 350 点再次买入”与“已经超卖、错误抛售”
SNDK25+看涨+6.02%，在抗操纵内存股中排名第二； 1700/1750/1800 预计会出现失控走势；提醒人们“即使在一次大的打击之后，它仍然会下跌”的历史模式； 8/5 收益
ORCL22+看跌-1.60%，被IBM拖累后继续受到打击； “一个月内从240到130”；社区猛烈抨击其软件难以使用，并称其“值得被做空”；有些人愿意在 130 美元以下进行底层捕捞
NVDA22+中性至看涨+0.77%，开盘于208点，先飙升后回落，一度接近持平；受到IBM“资本支出转移”解读的压力；抱怨它“被操纵/困在一个范围内，直到宇宙热寂”； 202.5 与 V 形反弹之间的分歧
AMD18+看涨+4.19%，被誉为“今年远比去年更有韧性”；分析师经常将目标价提高至 700 以上，但股价却停留在 520-580 区间
NOW15+看跌-5.75%，SaaS抛售的主要受害者； “IBM是一家垃圾潮公司，为什么现在要拖垮它”；有些后悔昨天没卖
